chunks: Muhammad, from Al-Fadl, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I said to him, 'Does the man blow in the place of his forehead during the prayer?' So he said, 'No.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to blow air on the forehead during prayer?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the etiquette of *sujdah* by prohibiting the act of blowing air at the forehead's resting spot, likely to preserve the dignity and purity of the prostration posture. This ruling underscores the Shia emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) within ritual acts, ensuring that minor actions do not detract from the solemnity of connecting with the Divine. It reflects the broader jurisprudential principle that the physical environment of prayer should be treated with reverence, avoiding unnecessary disturbances during the moment of deepest humility.
